about.title: About this page
about.paragraph1: This page was developed using SvelteKit as a static build framework, TypeScript as the main language and Tailwind CSS for styling.
about.paragraph2: You can check out the source code at GitHub, where it is published under the GNU GPLv3 License. The page is automatically built as a full static site with GitHub Actions and hosted in GitHub Pages.

index.interests: I am passionate about automation and clean code. As a consequence, I am very interested in strongly automated development processes (CI/CD), containerization and other ways to improve code quality and developer experience.
index.introduction: I am a senior Android engineer from Santiago de Compostela, Spain. I am mainly an Android developer, but I have experience and training in other areas and technologies such as DevOps, web frontend and scripting.

me.intro: I am Álvaro [al - βa - ɾo]. I am a software engineer from Santiago de Compostela, Spain. I enjoy trying new technologies and as a consequence I have a somewhat generalist background. However, most of my experience is in Android development.
me.automation: As a developer, I am guided by the DRY principle and strongly dislike duplication of both code and work. Partly due to this, I am proactive about automating tasks and processes whenever I can. This is something I apply in my daily work by authoring scripts, containers, CI and tooling config, etc. Several of my published repos also focus on automation or developer experience.
me.opensource: I am also an advocate for open-source software. A significant part of my career has been spent working on open-source projects, and I also publish most of my personal projects (like this page!) for whoever might find them useful, and contribute to third-party repos.
me.personal: When I'm not coding, you can probably find me playing disc golf or video games, messing around with a 3d printer, playing with my dog, or trying to automate physical things with Home Assistant.
